race.description: Nijinsky Standing At Yirribee Stud Pace
race.comment: STIPULATING (10) had a wide draw last start so prepared to overlook that result. Led for a win in this grade prior, getting home by nearly 4m at this circuit and distance. With even luck from the back row he could be back in the winners' list. TOBYS SHOUT (6) should find this easier than his latest appearance and had put together a string of top-four results prior including a placing the only time he raced here. With even he is luck capable of a strong performance. JUNGLE SHARK (3) draws better than last time and hadn't been too far off the placegetters in his previous two outings. PYEKAKARIKI (7) draws wide but could be competitive with even luck.
